# Introduction

The **`venn`** analysis (Venn Diagram) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Analysis for Venn Diagram
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPath)

# Load package test dataset
data("venn_test", package = "ClinicoPath", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings (add the required variable arguments
# for this analysis; see ?venn)
# ClinicoPath::venn(
#   data = venn_test
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `venn` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
